title: Real Form of the Constant-Pair Function
statement: For every natural number $n$, the real-valued version of the sign-valued function obtained from the indicator of the zero and all-ones vectors in the binary cube equals, at each sign vector, the real sign encoding of that indicator evaluated at the corresponding binary vector under the coordinatewise binary-to-sign identification.
hypotheses_covered: The function is obtained by sign-encoding the indicator of the zero and all-ones binary vectors
The binary and sign cubes are identified coordinatewise
